description: Usmeritve za vključitev tovornih koles v Strateški načrt za razvoj kolesarskega omrežja v Republiki Sloveniji (ŠTUDIJA) is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR. Elaborat osvetljuje pomen uporabe tovornih koles in s pregledom dobrih praks vključevanja te vsebine v strateške načrte različnih držav in mest daje predlog možnih ukrepov za spodbujanje uporabe tovornih koles v Sloveniji s ciljem doseči tovornim kolesom prijazna mesta. Coverage: MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR. The publisher named on the listing is MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR. Its keywords include tovorna kolesa, zelena logistika, trajnostna mobilnost, intermodalnost, kolesarska strategija. The listing shows 4 download or service links in HTML, PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
